description: Update an existing custom field definition (title, type, options, or mandatory flag) in your organization. The organization is fixed by your context. You cannot change a field's field_id or the entity it applies to. Only the properties you supply are changed.

field_definition_id.description: Id of the custom field definition to update (required). Must belong to your organization.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

is_mandatory.description: Whether a value is required when creating/updating the entity.

list_of_values.description: New options (for a ListOfValues field; at least one non-blank option).

type.description: New field data type. One of: String, Number, Date, DateTime, ListOfValues.

name: update_custom_field
